dataset: DROID: A Large-Scale In-the-Wild Robot Manipulation Dataset
creators: Alexander Khazatsky, Karl Pertsch, Suraj Nair, et al.
initial_posture: Raw action/joint_position, zero-based frame 40; seven numeric joint coordinates only. The independent 80-frame target tape reuses that posture with scripted joint-1 changes.
redistribution: No original raw trajectory, imagery, video, collector metadata or official flat export is bundled. Independently generated numeric simulation traces and the derived target tape are included with this attribution.
modifications: Independent box/contact geometry, gripper closure, joint-1 sweep and continuation commands; not a reconstruction of the source DROID interaction.
